plugin_desc: Jacarta interSeptor Pro environmental SNMP child template for devices under Jacarta PEN 19011. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. Proven ISPRO private increments under 1.3.6.1.4.1.19011.1.3.2 are isDeviceMonitorTemperature as env_temperature_celsius and isDeviceMonitorHumidity as env_humidity_percent, both scaled by /100, with sensor names as tags. Alarm disable(2) rows are dropped; normal(3) maps to status 1 and warning/critical 4-7 map to status 2. Temperature readings default to Celsius; confirm isConfigTemperatureUnit on site because Fahrenheit(2) is converted in the collector. CPU, memory, fan and PSU scalars are not invented. Classic interSeptor 1.3.1 and digital I/O are not collected in this pass. Supported brands/models - Jacarta interSeptor Pro monitors that expose the ISPRO monitor tables and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-sensor environment temperature in degrees Celsius from isDeviceMonitorTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.19011.1.3.2.1.3.1.1.1.3). The SNMP value is hundredths of a degree and is scaled by /100. Fahrenheit unit readings are converted to Celsius. Rows with alarm disable(2) are dropped. Empty tables yield no rows. Persistently high values may indicate cooling or ambient-temperature risk.

metrics.name: env_temperature_status
metrics.description: Per-sensor temperature alarm from isDeviceMonitorTemperatureAlarm, normalized to 1=normal and 2=abnormal. unknown(1) emits no status value; disable(2) drops the row.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Per-sensor relative humidity in percent from isDeviceMonitorHumidity (1.3.6.1.4.1.19011.1.3.2.1.3.1.2.1.3). The SNMP value is hundredths of a percent and is scaled by /100. Rows with alarm disable(2) are dropped. Empty tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: env_humidity_status
metrics.description: Per-sensor humidity alarm from isDeviceMonitorHumidityAlarm, normalized to 1=normal and 2=abnormal. unknown(1) emits no status value; disable(2) drops the row.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
